hook: Sabko barabar [[baaltiyon]] mein baanto, no favouritism

slides.title: NTILE(n) = [[n buckets]]
points: Sorted rows ko **n barabar groups** mein baanto
Har row ko milta hai **bucket number** 1…n
Jaise class ko **4 sections** mein baantna
slides.note: Bole toh: **headcount** ke hisaab se batwara, value se nahi

slides.title: Do [[baaltiyan]]
5 log, 2 [[buckets]]
slides.note: 5 ÷ 2 barabar nahi → extra row **pehle bucket** mein jaati hai

slides.title: Quartile = [[NTILE(4)]]
slides.note: Top 25% customers chahiye? WHERE bucket = 1, khatam 🎯

slides.title: Customer [[segments]]
slides.note: seg 1 = **Gold** 🥇, 2 = Silver, 3 = Bronze. Marketing team khush!

slides.wrong:
NTILE(2) → 50k se kam ek bucket,
upar wale doosre
slides.right: NTILE(2) → **rows ko gin ke** do barabar hisse
slides.why: Buckets **row count** se bante hain, value range se nahi. Range chahiye? **CASE** use karo

caption:
Sabko barabar baaltiyon mein baanto, no favouritism 🪣
